posts.text: ADHD isn’t random—it’s imagination without restraint. You feel this too?
They called it laziness. Turns out it was untreated ADHD the whole time.
ADHD brain says: ‘You can do it tomorrow.’ Tomorrow brain: ‘Who said that?’
ADHD is knowing what to do but not being able to do it — and hating yourself for it.
ADHD means forgets what I’m doing halfway through doing it but somehow, I still pull it off.
ADHD: Suddenly doing everything at 2am like a raccoon on a mission
